newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunker final report and prices - Feb 25.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunker final report and prices - Feb 25.

text.p: DELIVERED U.S.$/TONNE) 380 CST 180 CST MDO GAS OIL
COMMENTS - Bunker prices were down in active trading as sellers cut prices to secure sales. Sources said 380-cst was sold at a low $95.00 per tonne and a major sold several lots at $96.50.

180-cst traded at $103.50. Traders said volume was healthy with between 20,000 to 30,000 tonnes sold. Prices rebounded slightly late day on firmer crude values in the West, traders said. -- Singapore Newsroom (+65-870-3093)
